category.name: segments/registers

longdesc.para: The segment register instructions allow far pointers (segment addresses) to be loaded into the segment registers.

category.reference: SDM Section 1:3.4.2.1 In Mode64, CS, SS, DS and ES base is treated as 0 regardless of actual value. Segment register loads perform checks on these registers because values will be preserved on switching to CompatibilityMode.

SDM Section 3a:3.4.3 In systems in which multiple processors have access to the same descriptor tables, it is the responsibility of software to reload the segment registers when the descriptor tables are modified. If this is not done, an old segment descriptor cached in a segment register might be used after its memory-resident version has been modified.
